sources.quote: Microsoft fixes Microsoft 365 bug blocking access to Office apps
Microsoft fixes Office dialog that had nothing to say and wouldn’t go away

claims.statement: Microsoft fixed a bug that was blocking some Microsoft 365 users from accessing Office apps via an empty, unresponsive dialog box.

sources.quote: affected users may need an administrator command prompt to install it

claims.statement: Some affected users may need to use an administrator command prompt to install the fix.

sources.quote: Earlier this week, Microsoft resolved a known issue that was preventing some Microsoft 365 customers from accessing Office applications.

claims.statement: Microsoft resolved the issue earlier in the week.

analysis.headline: Microsoft fixes bug blocking Office app access via blank dialog
analysis.summary: Microsoft resolved a bug that showed an empty, unresponsive dialog box and blocked some Microsoft 365 customers from accessing Office applications. Some affected users may need an administrator command prompt to install the fix.
